RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 35

An all-male panel is not evidence of discrimination on its own — it's the norm in bank risk functions and reflects who holds senior posts. Treat it as context, not as your argument.

What is more probative: a candidate with weaker technical credentials won a modelling leadership role, and nobody will put the reasoning in writing. Silence after two weeks is the real signal.

So chase the written explanation first, in writing, with a deadline. Ask what criteria were used, how each was weighted, and how the two of you scored. If the reasons arrive vague, shifting, or absent, panel composition becomes one supporting fact among several — useful then, weak now.
